population: all 5518 mapped logged NBA/ESPN games in the retained snapshots, including one game on the current ET date; no model predictions
method: scripts.nbastats.nba_tables and espn_tables, then crosswalk with OUT patched to a new temporary directory; compare player_games_map against retained derived mapping without replacing it
limitation: ESPN box rows lack a player ID; stat-line resemblance is not a valid identity. The corrected mapping was tested only in temporary storage, and the retained production mapping was not rebuilt in this experiment.
